source.name: LaunchLoom owned design study
source.rightsEvidence: This is a LaunchLoom-owned original design study and its in-house rendered capture, stored for internal inspiration and implementation research.

heroGeometry.mode: oversized service poster beside a three-window project image stack
heroGeometry.alignment: dark text field beside tall image crops
heroGeometry.viewport: headline and request action visible before the next section

navigationGeometry.mode: small wordmark and direct utility links

imageTreatment.crop: one tall crop with two supporting windows

servicePresentation.interaction: open or navigate by service row

motion.reducedMotion: show the project image stack statically

rules: stack image windows in document order
keep both request and call actions reachable

acceptanceChecks: the service promise dominates the hero
images are clearly project evidence, not abstract decoration
service index follows the opening scene
referenceDna.annotatedDescription: Owned rendered garage-door repair study. The screenshot shows a large service poster beside finished-work image windows, followed by a direct repair index. It is not a 3D portfolio or sticky project stack.

review.scope: paired full-page evidence and transferable visual mechanics; not approval of sample business claims or production copy
